model.name: ตัวอย่างศึกษา · อาคาร 1 ชั้น

result.units: kN, m, rad; displacements also reported in mm
assumptions: Linear elastic, first order, rigid joints, gross rectangular sections
No slab/soil/RC capacity, cracking, creep, P-Delta, seismic or code checks
Loads and combination factors are user inputs; Y is vertical
Member forces and deflections use local axes; node outputs use global axes
Section J is an approximate Saint-Venant rectangular torsion constant
